en: A sepia-toned street scene in an older European town. On the left are multi‑story masonry buildings with simple facades and street lamps; two people stand on the sidewalk. On the right are low, weathered wooden houses or sheds with pitched roofs and a large leafy tree behind them. A narrow paved road runs through the middle with a small car parked further down the street. The overall look suggests an older residential district captured in a vintage photograph.
